method: Same deterministic 5 MiB binary payload encoded as a data URI; initial save plus 20 text/timer edits each separated by 500 ms using the Flutter fake test clock. Baseline executes the former full-module JSON serialization; optimized executes the actual controller debounce and repository with instrumented in-memory storage.
limitations: Debug-host algorithm timings are not device profile or disk latency measurements.
Baseline timing covers serialization; optimized timing additionally covers controller pumping, decoding/hash of the initial image, and in-memory persistence.
Metadata byte counts include the JSON draft document; the one-time small asset-intent boolean marker is not included.
Physical process restart is represented by fresh repository/data-source instances; separate native-file and real Chrome IndexedDB tests verify backend persistence across storage instances.
